Summary:

Highlights: 

5 Bed, 4 Bath, Sleeps 13

5 Bikes with Every Reservation

Located in the new South of 30A portion of the Town of Prominence on 30A

Access to 2 Pools (1 Seasonally Heated)



The Space:

Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 13):

- Master Suite I, First Floor: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower and Separate Tub

- Master Suite II, Second Floor: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower

- Guest Bedroom I, Second Floor: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower

- Guest Bedroom II, Second Floor: Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo

- Guest Bedroom III, Second Floor: 2 Sets of Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo

- Living Area, First Floor: Twin Sleeper Chair, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo



Reasons to Book La SEA-esta on 30A Today:

- 5 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms, Accommodates 13

- 5 Bikes

- 3 King Bedrooms

- 2 King Master Suites

- Electric car charging port in garage

- Located between Seaside, Watersound, and Alys Beach

- Large Resort Style Community Pool

- Outdoor Dining Pavilions

- Community Grills

- Community Green with Weekly Concerts

- Walk to the Beach

- Walk to Restaurants

- 2 Story Luxury Home

- High-end appliances and fixtures

- Fully Appointed Kitchen

- Full Size Refrigerator With Ice Maker

- Full Size Stove With Oven

- Tastefully Decorated with a Coastal Ambiance

- Pots, Pans, & Cooking Utensils Provided

- Blender, Toaster, Dishes & Eating Utensils Provided

- Complimentary Wireless Internet

- Full Size Washer & Dryer

- Parking for 1 Vehicle in the Garage

- Parking for 2 Vehicles in the Driveway

- Additional parking in parallel gravel spots in front of the property (first come first serve, not guaranteed).

- Close To Local Restaurants and Shopping

- Resort Linens and Terry Program (excludes beach towels)

- Snowbird-Friendly Monthly Rates

- Safe & Contact-Free Check-in

- 24/7 Professional Management



Enjoy our 5 bikes, to cruise down 30A in Style!

Quick rides to the beach, Seaside, Watercolor and more!!



Relaxation and coastal adventures await at our La SEA-esta at the Town of Prominence 30A; offering resort accommodations for up to 13 guests in 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms.



Recently built and tastefully decorated with a coastal ambiance, this two-story luxury home offers a carefree and relaxing atmosphere for your coastal escape! Just minutes from Seaside, Watersound, and Alys Beach, The Town of Prominence is located between all the best of 30A!



30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida's beautiful Gulf Coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald blue waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairy tale like scene against some of the country's most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.



This home is on our Resort Linen and Terry Package with guaranteed fresh linen and terry placed every turn! (excludes beach towels)



Parking & Transportation:

- Parking: There is parking for 2 vehicles in the driveway. There is parking for 1 vehicle in the garage. There is additional parallell street parking on the graven in-front of the property. This is first come first serve and is not guaranteed.

- Bicycles: Enjoy 5 adult bikes to explore 30A in style (Amenity Fee applies at Checkout).



Guest Access:

Community Pools in Prominence (North and South):

North Pool Hours: 8AM – 9PM Heated Seasonally*

South Pool Hours: 8AM - Dusk

No Lifeguard on Duty & Children Under 13 Must be Accompanied by an Adult

No Hot Tubs

No Glass

No Flotation Devices

*Note: Pool access, availability, and heating are subject to change at the discretion of the HOA. BeachWalk is not responsible for any modifications.



Beach Accesses: There are several convenient beach accesses*! Below are 3 of the most popular accesses:

- Gulf Lakes Beach Access: The Gulf Lakes access is a Walton County beach access located about 1 mile to the East of Prominence.

- Deer Lake State Park: Deer Lake is located 0.5 miles West of Prominence. This access has a small parking area at the access (~$3-$5 for parking) and bathrooms, but the walk from the parking area to the beach is a bit longer than most area accesses. IMPORTANT - Because this is a state park, and not a Walton County beach access, alcohol is not allowed & beach service is not available at this location.

- Santa Clara: Santa Clara access is a Walton County, ADA approved, beach access located near Bramble Grove Road, about 3.5 miles to the west of Prominence. Parking and bathrooms are also available at this access.

*Note: Prominence homes access the beach via South Walton public beach access points. Most guests typically use the Deer Lake State Park beach access or other nearby public access points. Prominence homes do not offer direct beach access through the Watersound Club, nor do they provide access to the private Watersound Club facilities.



Parking in Prominence (North and South):

- North Prominence Triplex (A, B, C) Unit Parking: Parking is only allowed in the garage (if available) and/or the driveway of the unit being rented. Parking in unassigned driveways is prohibited and may result in towing or fines. No street parking or overflow parking is permitted in Prominence North. Additional parking is available at The Big Chill (formerly The Hub).

- South Prominence Parking: Parking is available in the driveway or garage of the home (if available). Street parking is allowed, but additional parking in the gravel spots on Pleasant and Clipper streets is first-come, first-served.

Pool Parking: No overnight parking is allowed at the pool area.

Trailer/Boat Parking: There is no trailer parking available.



Golf Cart/LSV (Low-Speed Vehicle) Rentals in Prominence: If your property does not come with a golf cart, you are only permitted to rent one through 30A Gulf Carts. Prominence strictly allows the rental of street-legal golf carts for guest use through this provider only. Questions regarding this policy should be directed to the Prominence HOA.



Nearby Restaurants: Nearby restaurants to The Town of Prominence 30A include The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) which offers several restaurants including - Red's Chicken Shack, Crave Roadside Burgers, Mile Marker 15, Local Smoke, American Drinking Post, Mr. Freeze, Food Trucks, and more!



Nearby Grocery Shopping: Publix at Watersound Origins, located on US 98 at North Watersound Parkway, approximately 3 miles away. Publix in Watercolor Crossing, located on South County Hwy 395, approximately 5 miles away.



The Neighborhood:

The Town of Prominence is 30A's newest vacation destination boasting resort style pools, private cabanas, hammocks, and outdoor dining pavilions with communal grilling area. A short walk across 30A, residents enjoy access to The Big Chill, which features restaurants, boutique shops, and The Prominence Town Center event pavilion with weekly concerts and movie nights! The Town of Prominence is sure to provide an unforgettable vacation experience for the whole family. 30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida's beautiful Gulf Coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald blue waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairy tale like scene against some of the country's most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.



Interaction with Guests:

We kindly request that parents and guardians accompany their children during

their visit/stay in Prominence. While we understand the allure of independence,

our community is best experienced when families are together, exploring the

nearby beautiful beaches, enjoying The Hub Shoppes and The Big Chill and

savoring the moments that make family vacations memorable.



- Prominence neighborhood restrictions begin at 9 PM for 18 & under; minors must be accompanied by an adult while on Prominence property during times when curfew is active



The 2026 Curfew Dates are Established as:

- March 7th thru April 5th

- July 3rd thru July 6th

- September 4th thru September 7th

- October 9th thru October 18th
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
